title: CE31202: Advanced Structural Analysis

Introduction â Background - Concepts of Finite Element â discretisation
techniques â Concepts on Weighted Residual and Direct continuum approach.
Development of Element Library for 1-D Analysis â Concept of Shape function Use of 1-D Elements for Analysis â Local co-ordinate system. Development of
